{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy conversion thruster''' was a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that pulled in waste material from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] process and then vaporized it in a controlled fusion reaction. The result generated thrust. [[SlaynRoche Co.]]'s [[Verpine asteroid director]] utilized an energy conversion thruster.
